summary:
Complete revised 3D Visualization implementation plan (Phase 5). Key architectural decisions:

1. **React Three Fiber (R3F)** as render framework — frameloop="demand" gives dirty rendering, automatic disposal, and native React integration.

2. **Cuboids vs Tetrahedra** — the ONLY difference between FDM and FEM. Two geometry builders, one renderer. No discretization forks anywhere else.

3. **Universe / Multi-Object model** — scene contains Universe with optional airbox + multiple objects. Each object is a selectable, pickable entity. Element markers link faces to objects.

4. **Synchronized camera** — all viewport panes share one camera store. Rotating in any pane rotates all simultaneously. Per-pane config controls only layer visibility and display mode.

5. **Interactive picking** — R3F raycasting gives face/cell index + world position. Element markers resolve to object ID. Probe tooltip shows quantity value at clicked cell.

6. **LOD / density control** — backend sampling profiles (quality/balanced/interactive/memory_saver), max_glyphs/max_points budgets, client-side stride and decimation for large simulations.

7. **Wireframe = mesh view** — wireframe layer IS the mesh visualization.

8. **Full API audit** confirmed data flow works end-to-end. 9 gaps identified (API facade methods + resource hooks + npm install).

Organized as 5 detailed sub-documents covering architecture, render pipeline, multi-viewport, domain adapters, and testing.
